purpose: Three design-element alternatives using the original near-chin hand and rightward brush pose.

records.label: A 方折青墨
records.prompt:
Create ONE finished character design variant by combining these two images. IMAGE 1 is the STRICT POSE/COMPOSITION reference: keep its full-body stance, shoulder/hip direction, slightly lowered front-three-quarter LEFT head, head location and size, one hand thoughtfully near chin, opposite hand holding ONE oversized calligraphy brush across the waist/body toward SCREEN RIGHT with tuft pointing down-right, all arm/hand/leg positions, large curved background landscape scroll and two rollers. Do not invent a new gesture, move the brush upright or turn the head differently. Correct anatomy and actual brush grip.
IMAGE 2 supplies the NEW character design elements ONLY: hairstyle, face identity, clothing tailoring, colors and ornaments. Organically fit that design onto image1's original pose. This must not be a repaint of image1's original teal bob/slit dress. Keep adult character proportions and the chosen variant's distinct silhouette. Background scroll remains like image1, with large gray ink mountains and simple birds, not redesigned.
Same project gem-icon rendering: confident dark outlines, few broad coherent matte color/value planes, restrained detail, no tiny noisy facets, microtexture, glossy realism or new accessories. Full original scroll, brush, clothing and boots safely within square warm ivory plain background. No labels, panels, title, watermark or extra figures. VARIANT A: preserve image2's cropped dark-teal angular hair with ivory wedge fringe, rectangular jade comb, adult firm scholarly face, square jade shoulder piece, ivory diagonal cross-lapel, wide teal sash with rectangular seal buckle, squared cuffs and stepped tabard edges, roomy ivory trousers and dark boots. Angular seal-carving motif in only one large area. Replace image2's two-handed low-left brush pose with image1's near-chin hand and opposite one-handed brush extending right. Preserve square-cut design and jade/ivory/ink palette, not image1's original costume.
